correctness.rationale: Independently re-verified the 84-row computational core: all 12 SPLIT identities (t-1)(t-b)^(l-1)(t-b+1) hold symbolically; all 72 NON_SPLIT rows carry valid divisor-exhaustion certificates (66 kind-A, 6 kind-B; nonzero constants; SymPy Z-factor lists confirm no linear factor); spot recomputation with chi_count.py reproduces the full-arrangement formula and deletion fits; the Terao non-freeness direction is valid. FATAL DEFECT: the S_l symmetry lemma (DRAFT 1bis) is FALSE. Counterexample: in cShi(B_3,2) with S={-1,0,1,2}, the swap x1<->x2 sends H={x1-x2=2z} in A to {x1-x2=-2z}, not in A since -2 is not in S (verified: permuted set differs with |B-A|=1). Position dependence confirmed numerically (deleting x1-x3=2z vs x1-x2=2z differs at p=29: 146132 vs 145656). Hence the 6k+1 reps do NOT determine chi/freeness for all 2kl^2+1 hyperplanes, and all 'hence for every H' and l(l-1) count claims are unproven as stated.

originality.rationale: Route is EMERGENT_FINDING, genuinely derived from the blocked all-k target via the same Crapo-Rota method on six certifiable blocks (per target_exit.json), not a convenient replacement. Fused 3-direction literature search (20 results; OpenAlex/Crossref/OpenAIRE ok, one Google query error) plus full-text inspection of the two nearest priors shows no source tabulating single-deletion chi values of cone extended Shi type B or the extreme-translate splitting rule; the nearest theorem (SRB Thm 3.3) decides only freeness for extreme deletions and implies no chi polynomial. The 84-row certified table is new.

value.rationale: The 84-row certified table answers the admitted target's three questions (exact chi, integral factorization, freeness obstruction) on six (l,k) blocks for a translate-complete slice of deletions of the natural object cShi(B_l,k), motivated before computation; the values are not known or mechanically implied; the extreme-splitting dichotomy versus proven non-splitting, plus residual invariants (e.g. t^2-37t+353) and the sign-flip counterexample, are directly reusable for arrangement-theory follow-up, and every row reproduces deterministically. The false S_l lifting overstates scope but does not erase the computed core's retrieval value once narrowed.
